paras: Hemidactylus lopezjuradoi is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to the Cape Verde Islands.
In the Cape Verde Islands H. lopezjuradoi has only been found on the island of Fogo.
The specific name, lopezjuradoi, is in honor of Spanish herpetologist Luis Felipe López-Jurado.
Adult H. lopezjuradoi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 4 cm (1.6 in).
